subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 10/10] mountd: bound the retry queues

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch bounds the retry queues in the mountd service to prevent them from growing indefinitely. The queues are used when a client's filehandle or fsid cannot be immediately verified as exportable, and they can become large due to unmounted exports on the server. The patch introduces a cap of 1024 entries for each queue and drops new requests once this limit is reached. This change prioritizes latency over correctness, as the kernel will repeat the upcall when the client retries. Deduplication mechanisms are also added to reduce memory usage in these queues.
